items.headline: Historic-inventory home at 1391 Washington Street eyed for 1,200 sq ft ADU
items.summary: The November 5 Historical and Landmarks Commission agenda listed a public hearing on a recommendation for a 1,200-square-foot detached accessory dwelling unit and a detached 347-square-foot garage at 1391 Washington Street (PLN26-00020), a property on the city's Historic Resource Inventory. The item was a Significant Property Alteration / Architectural Review and was listed as categorically exempt from CEQA.

items.headline: Heritage commission agenda: SB 9 lot-split changes and Asian American history
items.summary: The November 4 Heritage Preservation Commission agenda listed a presentation on recent changes to SB 9 (including SB 450 and AB 1061) affecting two-unit developments and urban lot splits in single-family zones. It also listed a draft update to the city's Historical Context Statement to add contributions by Asian Americans and other minority groups, a Council priority project.

items.headline: Rosendin Electric office tenant improvement permitted at 3000 Orchard Parkway
items.summary: A building permit was issued for a Rosendin Electric tenant improvement, an interior build-out of an existing office building at 3000 Orchard Py. The permit valuation is $10,255,535, the highest among the permits in this feed.

items.headline: Church tenant improvement permitted at 5891 Rue Ferrari
items.summary: A permit was issued for the First Church Religious Assembly tenant improvement at 5891 Rue Ferrari, an interior build-out of an existing building for church use. The permit valuation is $2,225,000.

items.headline: Cupertino agenda: $11.8M from parkland fund for Finch Avenue property
items.summary: The November 2 City Council agenda listed a budget modification adding $11,825,000 to the Parkland Dedication Fund to purchase the Finch Property at 10480 Finch Avenue. The item appeared on the consent calendar.

items.headline: Cupertino agenda: $850,000 Caltrans grant for McClellan Road Bridge design
items.summary: The November 2 City Council agenda listed a resolution to accept $850,000 in Caltrans-administered Community Project Funding. It also listed a design services agreement with Biggs Cardosa Associates, Inc. for up to $1,278,700 for the McClellan Road Bridge Project.

items.headline: Cupertino agenda: study session on updating 2019 Emergency Operations Plan
items.summary: The November 2 City Council agenda listed a study session on proposed updates to the city's 2019 Emergency Operations Plan, the document that guides the city's response to disasters.

items.headline: City Hall advisory committee agenda: building conditions and future options
items.summary: The City Hall Community Advisory Committee's October 29 agenda listed a discussion and input item on City Hall's existing conditions, facility needs, and future options. The public could comment in person, by Zoom, or by email to CityHallCAC@santaclaraca.gov.
